highlights_headline: The collected 4.150.6 changes improve Ganesh failure tracking and GPU buffer-upload checks.

bullets.lead: Failed tasks remain failed through flush
bullets.detail: Separates whether a render task executed from whether it succeeded, including intermediate GPU submission failures. Existing managed flush signatures remain unchanged.

Adds checked buffer-upload and initialization paths to reduce stale drawing under GPU memory pressure, and retains CPU triangulation data for retries. This does not establish complete coverage of every upload-failure path.
